purpose: replaceable platform adapter contract for QSOL-TIMELOCK publication execution

adapter_contract.plan: produce a side-effect-free execution plan bound to a structurally validated cleared publication receipt
adapter_contract.execute: rederive and compare the plan, revalidate the contract and clearance, recheck the current trusted runtime clock, then perform a platform action only after explicit current authority and runtime credentials are supplied
adapter_contract.observe_postcondition: verify the platform-reported target state after action

credential_policy.endpoint_binding: runtime credentials may only be sent to the endpoint deterministically derived from the validated subject

future_platform_rule: replace the adapter, not the timelock intent or safety gates
